questions.q: What kind of horses were at the sale with Black Beauty?
choices: Old, broken-down horses, some lame or broken-winded
Young racehorses that had never been ridden
Fine carriage horses from rich men's stables
Little ponies for children to ride
questions.evidence: I found myself in company with the old broken-down horses

questions.q: Who was with the gentleman farmer at the sale?
choices: His grandson Willie
His wife Mrs. Thoroughgood
Jerry Barker
Joe Green
questions.evidence: There's a horse, Willie, that has known better days

questions.q: How could the farmer tell Black Beauty had once been a fine horse?
choices: From his nostrils, ears, neck and shoulder
From a name tag fixed to his old bridle
Because the seller told him the horse's whole history
From the fine, shining color of his coat
questions.evidence: look at his nostrils and his ears, the shape of his neck and shoulder

questions.q: What did Willie ask his grandfather to do?
choices: Buy him and make him young, as with Ladybird
Leave the sale quickly before it rained
Buy a little pony for him to ride to school instead
Sell their own colt to pay for the horse
questions.evidence: Could not you buy him and make him young again as you did with Ladybird?

questions.q: How much did Mr. Thoroughgood pay for Black Beauty?
choices: Five pounds
Twenty pounds
Two pounds
Fifty pounds
questions.evidence: Five pounds, sir; that was the lowest price my master set

questions.q: The farmer calls buying the horse "quite a speculation!" What does "speculation" mean here?
choices: A risk that might or might not pay off
A sure bargain that cannot lose
A big mistake that he would always regret
A gift from a kind friend
questions.evidence: 'Tis a speculation," said the old gentleman

questions.q: What job did Mr. Thoroughgood give Willie?
choices: To take the oversight of the horse
To sell the horse again in the spring
To ride the horse in the village races
To clean out the stable at the inn
questions.evidence: "you, Willie," said he, "must take the oversight of him

questions.q: What did Willie call Black Beauty?
choices: Old Crony
Jack
Blackie
Old Captain

questions.q: What happened in March after the winter's rest?
choices: He was tried in the phaeton and did the work with ease
He was sold to a cab owner who came looking for a strong horse
He fell ill again and could not work
He was taken back to the horse sale
questions.evidence: I did the work with perfect ease
